title: Capture travel requirements and define guide scope
acceptance: Capture destination or candidate destinations; origin; travel dates or date window; trip length; traveler count and composition; total or daily budget; pace; interests; must-go and must-avoid items; transport preferences; lodging preferences; food constraints; mobility or schedule constraints; passport/visa assumptions when relevant; desired output format. Then summarize confirmed requirements
min_capability_tier: and propose the smallest downstream task set needed to produce the guide. Do not invent missing operator preferences.
tool_requirements: First task of the standalone UOS travel pilot. Present the completed requirements artifact directly in conversation for operator confirmation before any new warmup claim.
